blocks.h2: When a Clog Needs a Plumber
blocks.body: Call when plunging hasn't worked, when the same drain clogs again within weeks or when you notice a sewer smell. In a building with several units, notice who else is affected. If it's just your sink, the clog is in your branch line. If neighbors have slow drains too, or the basement floor drain is filling, the shared main line is blocked and needs [sewer rodding](/chicago-lincoln-park/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

blocks.h2: Clogged Drain Repair in Lincoln Park
bodies: Hair and soap in bathroom drains, grease and food in kitchens and lint in laundry lines cause most clogs. We clear them with a cable sized for the pipe and show you what came out.

Older buildings often have galvanized and cast iron drains inside the walls. They narrow over time, so clogs come back sooner. A camera look tells us whether a stubborn drain needs [hydro jetting](/chicago-lincoln-park/hydro-jetting) or a section of pipe replaced.
Grease causes most kitchen clogs. It cools on the pipe walls and catches food and soap until the sink stops draining.

In a condo or two-flat, kitchens on different floors often share one stack. If your sink backs up when the neighbor's dishwasher runs, the clog is in the shared line. If a disposal is involved, see [garbage disposal repair](/chicago-lincoln-park/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Lincoln Park Homes
blocks.intro: Older pipes and shared lines make clogs more common here.

items.body: Kitchens and baths stacked floor over floor drain into one vertical pipe.
When several units are slow, it's the main. See [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When the basement floor drain backs up or every unit's drains slow down, the main sewer drain is blocked. Clearing it takes a machine that can run from the cleanout to the city sewer.

We clear the line and camera it, so you see the cause. In Lincoln Park, it's usually roots in old clay or grease from several kitchens. If it keeps happening, we'll go over [sewer rodding](/chicago-lincoln-park/sewer-rodding), [hydro jetting](/chicago-lincoln-park/hydro-jetting) or a [sewer repair](/chicago-lincoln-park/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Do you do emergency drain cleaning in Lincoln Park?
items.answer: Yes. Call any time and we'll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: My sink backs up when my upstairs neighbor runs water. Why?
items.answer: Your units share a drain stack, and the clog is in the shared part below your sink. We clear it from the best access point.

items.q: Is it my drain or the building's?
items.preview: One fixture is yours. Several units is the building's.
items.answer: If only your fixture is slow, it's likely your branch line. If other units are affected, it's the shared line.

items.q: Should I use a chemical drain cleaner?
items.answer: We don't, especially in older buildings. Chemicals can damage old pipe and rarely clear the clog.

items.q: Can you clear a clog in a high-rise unit?
items.answer: Yes, within your unit's lines. Building stacks are usually handled by building staff.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on where the clog is. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. You'll approve a flat price before we start.
